verdict.rationale: Firebase ships official client/Admin SDKs (Auth, Firestore, Functions) and an official CLI/MCP server that AI agents can use to build and manage Firebase resources programmatically, with hands-on probes confirming the CLI and MCP server actually run and respond (firebase-probe-5, firebase-probe-6). Community reports also corroborate developers building real apps quickly on top of these SDKs (firebase-comm-14, firebase-comm-18). Missing for 10: explicit enumeration of platform-specific SDKs (iOS/Android/Unity/C++), independent third-party benchmarking of SDK completeness/documentation quality.
